integration: The factory selects the original JIT function by name from its AST and loads it with the pinned Triton Ascend runtime. The GPU definition is retained verbatim.
gpu_ast_serialization: Python 3.13 ast.dump of an ast.Module with the topk_gating_softmax_kernel function node as its body, an empty type_ignores list, and location attributes omitted. Encode as UTF-8 before hashing.
